caption:
BANK NIFTY HITS 63,000 RECORD HIGH AS MARKETS RALLY

The BSE Sensex rose 558.47 points to 82,590.28 and the Nifty 50 climbed to 25,400.70. Bank Nifty broke the 63,000 barrier, driven by strong banking and auto stocks.\nThe rally was supported by foreign inflows, lifting overall market sentiment. With banks accounting for a record share of the index, the move highlights the sector’s influence on broader market direction.

For information only. Not investment advice.
